The leaker who previously spotted the upcoming iPhone Duo feature hidden in Apple's code has now uncovered something similar on the HomePad. The upcoming device's setup process shares a common feature with Apple's foldable iPhone.

The leaker says the setup will be done in the Home app and has shared three screenshots of the setup process……

iPhone Duo StandBy mode

Apple's StandBy mode offers a number of options that turn your iPhone into a useful information display while it's charging. The leaker pdfu has previously shared five unannounced iPhone Duo StandBy screens found in the Xcode simulator.

  • Home Camera
  • Home Modular
  • Flow
  • Fade
  • Snoopy

HomePad setup screen

One of the StandBy screen options is Photo Face, and pdfu says HomePad will also have this feature.

He explained that the setup will have the device pull a handful of hi-res photos for you to pick from right away, while your full photo library slowly downloads from iCloud.

Apple's smart home hub is expected to launch on October 13th with a design inspired by the iMac G4. You can read more about that design here.
